rows.label: qst500108_msg0001
rows.name:
This is no time for leisurely
greetings, mo!

rows.label: qst500108_msg0002
rows.name:
It's already been 100 days since
Ruriruri started looking for delicious
juice ingredients, mo!

rows.label: qst500108_msg0003
rows.name:
I was walking beside the ruins looking
for Ice Cabbage when I slipped and
fell all the way down, mo!

rows.label: qst500108_msg0004
rows.name:
It was too scary to jump down, so
I've lived here for 99 days, mo!

rows.label: qst500108_msg0009
rows.name:
If I flap these ears like wings,
I should be able to land softly, mo!

rows.label: qst500108_msg0010
rows.name:
Climbing back to where I fell from
should be easier than jumping farther
down, mo.

rows.label: qst500108_msg0011
rows.name:
Since I fell here, I assumed I had
to keep falling, and couldn't work up
the courage, mo...

rows.label: qst500108_msg0012
rows.name:
I can't believe I missed this. The
Ice Cabbage hunt and cold must have
gotten to me, mo...

rows.label: qst500108_msg0013
rows.name: Thanks for the great idea, mo!

rows.label: qst500108_msg0014
rows.name:
Some of my other siblings are also
looking for juice ingredients, mo.

rows.label: qst500108_msg0015
rows.name:
If you meet them, please be as kind
to them as you were to me, mo!
